mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially increasing clearance of infliximab and reducing its therapeutic concentration, while also potentially increasing immunogenicity through altered TNF-alpha dynamics during tuberculosis treatment.
action: Monitor infliximab efficacy closely; consider alternative antimycobacterial agents (e.g., isoniazid-based regimens without rifampin) or increased infliximab dosing if concurrent use is unavoidable; assess for TB before starting TNF inhibitors.
